notes: Ethereum COLLECTION launch of Worker Frens (wFREN), 2222 on-chain pixel frens. Deploy exactly PlaceFrens (src/FrensPlacement.sol, no arguments), then PlaceModules (same file, one address argument: $contract:PlaceFrens). PlaceFrens creates FrenPrices and IMD6900Frens; PlaceModules creates FrenSwapper, FrenMinter and FrenWorkerGate. The ART launch is already live (IMD launch 1067): WorkerFrensRenderer 0x0a2e5e0c1d00fe63ab4e391c052a023cc7a16292. Do not bundle art contracts into this transaction. The collection launch uses about 12.45M gas all in; test_EachLaunchFitsOneTransaction accounts for creations, calldata and launcher overhead and requires 1M gas to spare below the 2^24 transaction limit. The pinned creation code in src/FrensCode.sol and salts in src/FrensPlan.sol use the standard CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C: collection 0x6900d042460d6bdbe68CE994F4dE36706797CCd4, swapper 0x69002297DD7980af0d24249f6a44E7046B1Cb1fb, minter 0x46B50a3061Ea692e075231c13bc653FdD1Bedd29, gate 0xF83807Ec2E27e1771Fb2594139c1F6925Cfd9B8E, prices 0x8f135B75Df156e6346c8525E138bC2BD652146ff. Existing exact deployments are reused; a pre-placed swapper with its average outside the 2x spot band is replaced by a plain CREATE from PlaceModules. Always read PlaceModules.swapper(); a replacement needs its own timelock fee exemption. Without the standard deployer, the launch uses its own CREATE2 and calls no pre-existing contract. The team wallet 0x35dA9C0303507ddf708E87F2568EdDf12c47a059 is owner and governor of the collection and owner of the gate; the factory and placement contracts retain no role. Keeper, relayer and job payee remain the pinned FrensPlan values. Constructors are nonpayable, receive zero ETH and need no factory initialization calls. After the collection launch, the team runs script/frens/DeployFrens.s.sol setup() with MODULES from this launch and RENDERER set to the live art renderer.
